description: Matched contrasts between ordinary-object transport and canonical stock-surreal substitutions.
pairing: Both sides transform the same mundane anchor; negatives route through a deliberately explicit stock-prop lexicon.
positive_depaysement: The receipt becomes a row of wet steps beneath the counter.
The blue mug carries a small bus route around the sink.
The spreadsheet opens a laundry line between two columns.
The delivery label grows a corridor through the cardboard box.
The refrigerator shelf holds a patch of afternoon rain.
The comb releases a queue of windows into the morning light.
The printer tray becomes a shallow field of folded invoices.
The grocery list turns into a handrail beside the kettle.
The elevator button keeps a second lobby inside its crack.
The charger cable carries the desk's shadow into the wall.
The laundry basket becomes a station for three loose socks.
The stapler unfolds a narrow bridge across the receipt.
negative_weird_noise: The receipt becomes an antique music box beneath the counter.
The blue mug carries a porcelain doll around the sink.
The spreadsheet opens a leather-bound book between two columns.
The delivery label grows an ornate clockwork corridor through the box.
The refrigerator shelf holds a moonlit crystal garden.
The comb releases a tiny ballerina into silver mist.
The printer tray becomes a velvet-lined cabinet of pocket watches.
The grocery list turns into a delicate Victorian key beside the kettle.
The elevator button keeps a miniature clock inside its crack.
The charger cable carries an old diary into a glass case.
The laundry basket becomes a dusty theater for porcelain figures.
The stapler unfolds an ornate music box across the receipt.
